headline: MLA Humayun Kabir announces retirement from politics over vote looting claims
summary: The Murshidabad MLA broke down in tears after being detained for 12 hours by police during a by-election in West Bengal.
details: Humayun Kabir, the MLA for Nauda in Murshidabad, indicated his retirement from politics following allegations of 'vote looting' during the by-election for the Reziganagar assembly seat.
caption:
A top leader of the Aam Aadmi Unnayan Party broke down in tears and announced his retirement from politics after alleging police-backed vote looting in West Bengal.

Humayun Kabir, the MLA for Nauda in Murshidabad, indicated his retirement from politics following allegations of 'vote looting' during the by-election for the Reziganagar assembly seat.

headline_marked: German tourist [[lost bag with laptop and camera]] in Natore
headline: German tourist lost bag with laptop and camera in Natore
summary: A man posing as a railway official stole the bag of Krill Lender Weber Penneiga, who was visiting Bangladesh's heritage sites.
details: German tourist Krill Lender Weber Penneiga lost his bag, containing a MacBook and a camera, after being deceived by a fraudster at Natore Railway Station on Wednesday afternoon.
The tourist stated that a man wearing a yellow vest, claiming to be a railway staff member, approached him in the waiting room and gained his trust.
Believing the man was an official, the tourist left his bag with him to buy a ticket, at which point the suspect vanished with the belongings.
With the help of local journalists, the tourist reported the incident to the police at the Natore Sadar Police Station.
Natore Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mansur Rahman stated that an online General Diary (GD) could not be filed because the victim is a foreign national without a Bangladeshi NID.
Despite the technicality, OC Mansur Rahman confirmed that a skilled police team is currently working to recover the stolen items by tracking the MacBook.
caption:
A man posing as a railway official stole a German tourist's laptop and camera in Natore.

German tourist Krill Lender Weber Penneiga lost his bag, containing a MacBook and a camera, after being deceived by a fraudster at Natore Railway Station on Wednesday afternoon.

The tourist stated that a man wearing a yellow vest, claiming to be a railway staff member, approached him in the waiting room and gained his trust.

Believing the man was an official, the tourist left his bag with him to buy a ticket, at which point the suspect vanished with the belongings.

With the help of local journalists, the tourist reported the incident to the police at the Natore Sadar Police Station.

Natore Sadar Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mansur Rahman stated that an online General Diary (GD) could not be filed because the victim is a foreign national without a Bangladeshi NID.

Despite the technicality, OC Mansur Rahman confirmed that a skilled police team is currently working to recover the stolen items by tracking the MacBook.

#Bangladesh #Natore #TravelSafety #Tourism #CrimeNews

Source: Jamuna TV, Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
